name: lowlight
description: Official Lowlight v1.0 IDE support: real-time syntax/type/ownership diagnostics, incremental sync, semantic tokens, rendered docs & links, autocomplete, hover, go-to-definition/type-def/declaration, cross-file references, workspace symbols, signature help, inlay hints, folding/selection ranges, code actions/refactorings, canonical formatting, and test runner.

lowlight.serverPath.description: Optional path to the `lowlight` compiler binary. When empty, uses the bundled binary inside the extension, workspace `./lowlight`, or `lowlight` on PATH.

lowlight.stdlibPath.description: Optional path to the directory containing Lowlight's `std/` modules.

lowlight.trace.description: Log raw JSON-RPC LSP messages to the Lowlight Output channel.

lowlight.format.indent.description: Default indentation style when `.lowlightfmt` is absent (`tabs` or `spaces`).

lowlight.format.tabWidth.description: Visual tab width (and space count when `lowlight.format.indent` is `spaces`) when `.lowlightfmt` is absent.

lowlight.format.lineWidth.description: Maximum target line width used by the Lowlight formatter when `.lowlightfmt` is absent.

lowlight.inlayHints.types.description: Show inferred type inlay hints on `let`/`bind`, loops, and optional bindings.

lowlight.inlayHints.parameters.description: Show parameter name inlay hints at function and method call sites.

lowlight.test.useTerminal.description: Run tests via the integrated terminal instead of VS Code's native Testing UI.
